name: Assassin
source:
The servant of [url=/c3542]Julius Harway[/url]. He is a serious fighter and has the ability to completely conceal his body.

[spoiler]His true identity is the Chinese martial artist Li Shuwen, and he is a master of Bājíquán. His Noble Phantasm is called No Second Strike.[/spoiler]
